scope: Consecutive packed CompressBN stages (CompressBNPacked::compress_v1) on the saved actual Init input: stage 1 verifies the per-column CompressGL proof (target/fused-arithmetic/init-bn), each later stage the previous stage's packed-SHPLONK proof. Development measurements; no release pin depends on them.
build: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/cuda cargo build --release -p ix-proof-compression --features cuda --example compress_bn_packed_stages
grouping_policy: target/commitment-reuse/agent4/p6.policy.json with CompressBN::step_v1 replaced by CompressBNPacked::{step_v1,predecessor} and KzgPackedVerifier::verify in KzgGroup_reuse (target/packed-bn-stages/p6-packed.policy.json)

setup.loader: SetupConfig::from_env -> for_stage -> gnark::load, anchors checked against the released Ignition parameters
setup.note: cap 2^26 requires quotient degree <= 4 (log cap + log q <= 28); the grouped Init system has quotient degree 4 under lookup budget 4

policy: anchors = Ignition; GL key/entry from the saved Init policy; BN key = BLAKE3 of this program's packed source-wire key, BN entry = CompressBNPacked::compress_v1

m4_next_row_planning.description: packs planned by height and declared next-row class (IXPSHC02 commitments)

i1_split_programs.description: I1: stage one and steady state as separate programs/keys (CompressBNPacked::first_v1 with the per-column verifier, CompressBNPacked::compress_v1 with the packed verifier only), packed policy IXAUKP01 pinning GL, first and steady keys. Byte streams; same p6 grouping as m4.

i2_word_streams.description: I2: word-level streams merged (u32 channels, word BLAKE3 driver, word transcript); same grouping policies as i1, so the new word functions are ungrouped circuits.

i2_word_streams_regrouped.description: I2 with policies updated for word streams: first program drops KzgTranscript::observe_bytes from KzgGroup_cold_b and adds small word functions to KzgGroup_reuse; steady program adds KzgGroup_packed_small (small packed-verifier and word functions) and KzgGroup_packed_mid (KzgPcsPacked::{columns_at,columns_onto,split,has_next,values} and word stream helpers).

i3_sharding_k2.description: I3: function-circuit sharding, up to 2 copies per circuit fixed in the key (IXAUSK02 copies field), copies chosen from the i2q stage-1 (first) and stage-3 (steady) reports with net saving >= 2^20 padded main cells at 3600 cells per extra committed column.

i3_sharding_k3.description: I3: as k2 with up to 3 copies (column cost only). Extra copies of wide groups re-evaluate their constraint graph in the next verifier; the column-only model under-counts that.

i3_sharding_k3_node_cost.description: I3: up to 3 copies with the cost model extended by 600 cells per constraint-graph node of every extra copy.

g1_packed_gl_chain.description: G1: CompressGL proven with packed SHPLONK on the actual Init root, then CompressBNPacked::chain_v1 at every BN stage (no per-column verifier program, no first_v1). Chain policy IXAUKG01 pins the packed GL key at stage one and the chain key afterwards.
g1_packed_gl_chain.command: IX_KZG_SRS=<ignition prefix> IX_KZG_CUDA_SRS_CACHE=1 LD_LIBRARY_PATH=<multi-stark cuda out> target/cuda/release/examples/compress_gl_packed_chain target/compress-gl/compress-gl.ixa target/compress-wrap/init-raw-root 55f0b8b04acdc211e249b538adcdab95fec15de6c9504ba875ffb52b1f1f8e86 target/packed-bn-stages/gl-chain/chain.ixa 26 4 OUT --lookup-budget 4 --quotient-degree 4 --streaming --gl-shards 2 --shards 2 --shard-profile target/packed-bn-stages/i3-shard2/stage-3/report.json
g1_packed_gl_chain.build: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/cuda cargo build --release -p ix-proof-compression --features cuda --example compress_gl_packed_chain
g1_packed_gl_chain.grouping_policy: target/packed-bn-stages/gl-chain/chain.policy.json: i2q-steady with CompressBNPacked::{policy,step,bn_previous} replaced by CompressBNPacked::chain_step in KzgGroup_reuse
g1_packed_gl_chain.root_input: target/compress-wrap/init-raw-root (root key 55f0b8b0..., claims c67d7ce5..., the same statement as the fresh Init run target/aiur-bn-bench/fresh-init-pinned-grouped; that run does not save the root proof)
observations: Packed CompressGL (budget 4, q 4, cap 2^26, k<=2 copies chosen from this execution): 87 points, 206,797 B proof (per-column 375,962 B), 6,140 values, 0 extra; prove 55.1 s + trace 29.3 s (per-column 46.7 s + 24.7 s); process peak RSS 109.8 GB (per-column compression 107.2 GB). 1.47B padded main cells, 1.21B committed after sharding.

Stage one (chain_v1 verifying packed CompressGL): 262.2M padded / 255.7M committed main cells, against 636.0M / 607.5M for first_v1 verifying the per-column proof (-58%); execution 3.9 s vs 41.9 s, prove 13.3 s vs 35.2 s, peak RSS 31 GB.
GL + first BN stage proving: 68.4 s vs 81.9 s (46.7 + 35.2), and the per-column first program/key disappear: one BN key (442,749 B) serves every stage.

Steady stages 2-4: 167.7M-169.9M committed (175.3M-177.4M padded), 121 KB proofs, 60-63 points, ~10 s prove. Slightly above i3 k2 (161.8M) because copies were planned from the i3 stage-3 report and only two circuits got copies here.

Shapes do not settle by stage 4: stage 2->3 changes 6 circuit heights, 3->4 changes one (KzgGroup_packed_small 8192 -> 4096); BN254Fq::from_limbs, assert_zero and a few ROM widths sit at a power-of-two boundary. This is the drift the normalization point (section 10) must absorb with configured capacities.
Every proof verifies natively, a changed last output word is rejected (GL and every BN stage), and every BN stage's deferred accumulator satisfies the pairing equation under the Ignition anchors.

stage_shapes_note: Stages 4 and 5 have exactly stage 3's circuit heights in both runs. Stage 1 runs the per-column verifier path (43 active circuits), stage 2 the packed path on a 43-circuit predecessor, stage 3 onward the packed path on a 76-circuit predecessor.
observations: verify_cells are the padded main cells of the stage execution that verifies the predecessor (whole CompressBNPacked step: policy/key/proof digests, verification, fold).

Shapes stop changing after stage 3 in both runs: stage 2 differs from stage 3 in 18 (height-only planning) or 16 (next-row planning) circuit heights, stages 3, 4 and 5 are identical. On Init a normalization point at stage 3 or later sees one predecessor shape; a second workload is still needed for capacities.

Next-row planning removes all extra values (135 / 839 per proof before) at the cost of 4-5 more packs; steady-state proof 186,415 -> 160,915 bytes and verification 358.9M -> 263.7M padded cells (one fewer power-of-two crossing).

Every stage: native verification accepts, a changed output is rejected, the deferred accumulator satisfies e(A,[1]2)e(B,[tau]2)=1 under the Ignition anchors; stage 1's accumulator equals the per-column Init baseline (source-claims.bin).
command_split: IX_KZG_SRS=<ignition prefix> IX_KZG_CUDA_SRS_CACHE=1 target/cuda/release/examples/compress_bn_packed_stages FIRST_ARTIFACT ARTIFACT 26 5 OUT --lookup-budget 4 --quotient-degree 4 --streaming [--shards K --shard-profile-first STAGE1_REPORT --shard-profile STAGE3_REPORT]
artifact_export_split: lake env MultiStark/.lake/build/bin/bn_grouping export ARTIFACT POLICY --compress --packed [--first]
observations_split_streams_sharding: Cells: main_cells_unpadded counts executed rows (function rows per circuit, ROM rows per width, full fixed tables); main_cells_padded is the unsharded power-of-two layout; main_cells_padded_committed is what the prover commits after sharding (equal to padded without sharding).

I1 (split programs): first key 379,542 B / 43 circuits, steady key 399,566 B / 76 circuits (single combined key was 463,203 B). Steady-state verification 263.7M -> 213.9M padded (172.2M unpadded); stage 2 190.5M padded. Proof 158,673 B, 4,692 values, 70 points.

I2 (word streams) with the byte-era grouping regressed padded cells (steady 256.0M, stage 1 854.9M) although unpadded fell (steady 148.2M): 16 new ungrouped word circuits (92 total), KzgGroup_reuse crossing 2^17 rows, and KzgTranscript::observe_bytes (per-byte push in the per-column commitment absorption, 345K rows) inside the 289-wide KzgGroup_cold_b. Transcript/digest bytes unchanged: kzg-xof.ixa and kzg-source.ixa regenerate byte-identically to the streams experiment and every native/Aiur check passes.

I2 regrouped (i2q): steady key 440,350 B / 42 circuits, proof 115,689 B, 3,444 values, 60 points; steady verification 175.5M padded / 129.5M unpadded (max height 2^19); stage 1 636.0M padded / 499.9M unpadded. Adding many members to an existing wide group widens it (columns add up across members): the i2p variant that put them into cold_b/cold_c (cold_b 289 -> 510 wide) measured 215.4M.

I3 (sharding, copies in key): k<=2 gives steady 161.8M committed padded (129.6M unpadded verification, unchanged) and stage 1 607.5M; k<=3 with a column-only cost model added 2.7K values to every steady proof and raised unpadded verification to 167M (each extra copy also re-evaluates the circuit's constraint graph in the next verifier); with 600 cells/node added to the model, k<=3 keeps steady at 163.1M/129.4M, cuts stage 1 to 541.0M but makes stage 2 213.2M (bigger first-program proof). Sharding also absorbs row drift across a power of two (k3 stage 4: KzgGroup_reuse 131,072+256+128 instead of 262,144).
Convergence: shapes are identical from stage 3 (i1, i2, i3 k2, k3+node cost) or stage 4 (i2q: one circuit height differs between stages 3 and 4).
